svg.title: The 342-byte certificate as nested boxes
svg.desc: The outer SEQUENCE holds three things: tbsCertificate (264 bytes, the part the CA signs, offsets 4 to 267), the signature algorithm (7 bytes) and the signature (67 bytes). Inside the signed part sit version, serial, algorithm, issuer, validity, subject, public key and extensions.

text.tspan: issuer CN=Root of Trust Toy CA
algorithm said twice: once inside the signed bytes, once outside
